briefTitle: First in Human Study of BAY2927088 in Participants Who Have Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) With Mutations in the Genes of Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) and/or Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2)

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1.

typedChecks.sourceText: Hemoglobin ≥ 9.0 g/dL. Criteria must be met without erythropoietin dependency and without packed red blood cell (pRBC) transfusion within 2 weeks prior to testing.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Hemoglobin ≥ 9.0 g/dL. Criteria must be met without erythropoietin dependency and without packed red blood cell (pRBC) transfusion within 2 weeks prior to testing.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: (small cell or mixed histologies are excluded)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of mixed histologies goes beyond standard single histology checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Documented disease progression after treatment with at least one prior systemic therapy for advanced disease. Participants who do not have standard of care access due to any reason, are intolerant to, or are not eligible for standard treatments, may also be eligible. Note: Except for participants eligible for Group F, Group H and Group I (Expansion or Extension) who should have received no prior systemic treatment for locally advanced or metastatic disease.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior lines depend on study arms and specific exceptions, making a simple typed check insufficient.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate archival tumor tissue (ideally taken after last targeted treatment and not older than 6 months) has to be available, either from primary or metastatic sites. If archival material is not available, a fresh tumor biopsy should be performed if feasible and if the procedure poses no significant risk for the participant.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or feasibility of undergoing a biopsy is subjective and procedural.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 (or by RANO-BM for participants in Expansion Groups G and H) with at least one lesion that can be accurately measured at baseline with computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and that is suitable for accurate repeated measurements.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Minimum life expectancy of 12 weeks.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with an EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) ≤ 8 days or 5x the terminal phase, elimination half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to the first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window depends on half-life calculations, not a simple static lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV exception rules involve multiple complex criteria and investigator discretion.
